identificationModule.briefTitle: A Two-blinded, Multicentre, Phase II/III RCT of Concurrent Chemo-radiotherapy Combined or Not Combined With TNF as the Therapy for LA-NPC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Two-blinded, Multicentre, Phase II/III RCT of Concurrent Chemo-radiotherapy Combined or Not Combined With TNF as the Therapy for Local-advancedNPC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Based on the application prospect of rmh-TNF combined with chemotherapy in the treatment of solid tumors. In this study, cisplatin combined with low dose 5-FU was proposed to enhance the immune function of 5-FU. Tianenfu is a novel recombinant modified human tumor necrosis with high activity and low toxicity. The fact that RMH-TNF has the potential of better in vivo efficacy and clinical antitumor effect. Therefore, the study was designed to investigate the treatment of concurrent chemoradiotherapy combined with TNF versus concurrent chemoradiotherapy combined with placebo for the efficacy and safety of advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

armGroups.label: Control group
armGroups.description:
Chemotherapy: 5-fu: 200mg/m2/d, continuous intravenous infusion on the 1st to 30th day of each cycle; Cisplatin: 80mg/m2, used on the 1st and 28th day of each cycle; Q60d; Every 2 months for a treatment cycle, use 2 cycles, a total of 4 months.

Radiotherapy: Radiotherapy was initiated on day 15 of the first cycle of chemotherapy GTV: 6810cGy (227 cGy/30f) Or 6996 cGy (212 cGy/ 33F); CTV: 5400-6000 cGy (180-200 cGy/f); Radiotherapy once a day, 5 times a week, a total of 30-33 times, a total of about 6 weeks.

Placebo: Normal saline 1-2ml, intramuscular injection, QD, 30 days in the first and third months, once a day.

armGroups.label: Experimental group
armGroups.description:
Chemotherapy: 5-fu: 200mg/m2/d, continuous intravenous infusion on the 1st to 30th day of each cycle; Cisplatin: 80mg/m2, used on the 1st and 28th day of each cycle; Q60d; Every 2 months for a treatment cycle, use 2 cycles, a total of 4 months.

Radiotherapy: Radiotherapy was initiated on day 15 of the first cycle of chemotherapy GTV: 6810cGy (227 cGy/30f) Or 6996 cGy (212 cGy/ 33F); CTV: 5400-6000 cGy (180-200 cGy/f); Radiotherapy once a day, 5 times a week, a total of 30-33 times, a total of about 6 weeks.

Tianenfu (recombinant human tumor necrosis factor for injection) : 1 million IU (BSA\<2.0m2) or 1.5 million IU (BSA≥2.0m2), dissolved in normal saline 1-2mL, intrascularization, QD, 30 days in the first and third months, once a day.
